QUI

2015-02-12

(no setlist)


This is the BLG version of Babes In Toyland as I opted for super close / center right in front of Kat. I shoved the soundcheck into the same link. I was in front of the line and it sounded clear enough to just start rolling. Best show of 2015 easy. Seen Qui plenty of times, doesn't seem to be much post pandemic activity for them.
